Hollow Knight save analyzer: what's missing for 112%

Stuck at 111%? Drop your save file here (user1.dat to user4.dat, one per slot) and the analyzer tells you what counts and what doesn't: charms, bosses, warrior dreams, the Colosseum of Fools' trials, equipment, spells, masks, vessels, the nail, the Dreamers, the Grimm Troupe and the pantheons. And beyond the 112%, every grub, Mask Shard, Vessel Fragment, Pale Ore and charm notch you have left, on the game's map.

The file is on Windows: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Team Cherry\Hollow Knight; on macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/unity.Team Cherry.Hollow Knight; on Linux, with Steam and Proton: ~/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/compatdata/367520/pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser/AppData/LocalLow/Team Cherry/Hollow Knight, and with the native version: ~/.config/unity3d/Team Cherry/Hollow Knight. With Steam Cloud that folder already holds the synced copy. In Chrome and Edge the site can follow the file: every time the game saves (resting at a bench or quitting), the page catches up on its own.

Questions

Why am I stuck at 111%?

It's almost always one thing: a fragile charm left with the Divine, a Vessel Fragment, a warrior dream or the last pantheon. The analyzer tells you which.

Does it change my save?

No. It only reads it: it never writes to the file and never uploads it anywhere.

What about consoles?

Consoles don't let you take the file out. You can tick your progress by hand on the 112% checklist.
